decisive_spans.text: SARS-CoV-2 antigen test positive (>5000 pg/mL) from oropharyngeal swab

response.rationale: Both D1 and D4 are supported by the positive SARS-CoV-2 antigen test. D4 is further supported by elevated inflammatory cytokines, which are a known feature of COVID-19-associated myocardial injury. D1 is supported by pulmonary infiltrates and pleural effusions, which are also present, but the primary cardiac involvement and inflammatory markers lean slightly more towards D4 as the most likely diagnosis given the options.
